messages:
Ivy Martinez: Quick Q for an upcoming offsite 1 We took a shared ride (6 people) from airport -> hotel and the driver provided one collective receipt showing the total. Two people used corporate cards, others used personal. How should we submit expenses and split fares?
people-ops-bot: Travel policy note -> Shared/group transportation: submit itemized proof showing each passenger's portion or a break-down signed by driver/ride app. If that's not available, provide the original receipt + a short distribution note and manager approval. Attach photos of attendees from the trip if needed.
Samir Patel: Practical process we've used:
- If ride-app supports split and shows each payer, each person files their own receipt/screenshot for the amount charged to their card.
- If one or two cards paid, those cardholders attach the full receipt and an itemization CSV explaining who reimbursed whom; personal card holders file reimbursements for their portion with that CSV attached.
- For corporate card coverage: corporate pays only the employee portion. If corporate card holder paid full amount, finance will request a ledger showing which passengers were company employees vs guests and will offset non-employee portions.
Jules Park: What about surge pricing or tolls that appeared after booking? Are those reimbursable?
Finance Bot: Surge/toll rules -> reimbursable when surge is unavoidable and travel was for approved business. For tolls, reimburse with receipt. For surge, include short justification (e.g., late flight arrival, no alternatives) and manager sign-off for amounts > $25. If surge was optional (chose faster ride to avoid walking), treat as personal unless manager pre-approved.
Ivy Martinez: Lost receipt scenario: driver lost the printed receipt. We have the app trip history showing total and participants but no PDF. Acceptable?
people-ops-bot: Yes, app trip history screenshot + card statement showing charge is acceptable for amounts under $75. For amounts >= $75, try to get a signed trip log from driver or a confirmation from the TMC/booking admin. Add a quick note in Concur: "no printed receipt - app history attached".
Samir Patel: Filing template we recommend:
```
Expense type: Ground Transportation (Shared)
Policy code: TRV-GROUND-SHARED-2026
Required attachments: app trip screenshot or receipt, card statement showing payment, distribution note for split, manager approval if > $25 surge or if corporate card covered full fare
Notes: list attendees and business purpose
```
Jules Park: One more: tips included vs cash tips. If tip was added in-app, attach the final charge screenshot. For cash tips, include a short note and amount; finance may request a second approver for large cash tips.
Ivy Martinez: Perfect 1 I'll collect screenshots and have our offsite lead sign the distribution note before filing. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
